description: Resolve a pointer (A{n}, seq/{n}, or paper/{id}) to the exact referenced item and provenance, never a whole file. An Articles pointer also returns the discussion thread (messages attached with entry_number). paper/{id} is a bibliography row. No write. Idempotent.

pointer.description: A pointer such as A12 (Articles entry), seq/340 (message), paper/<id> or campaign/<id>.
